title: reopen-browser-plain-keys with a page that paints nothing until its first key (reopen-f4, empty-page readiness; exploratory)
why: Lead request (STATUS 6493, review of #32207): plain keys (no Cmd/Ctrl) after a reopen must reach the restored page; reopen-browser-first-key starts with Cmd-L and cannot see their loss. No click (STATUS 7302/7362).

steps.title: set-up: Home finishes its first load

set-up: a local page (127.0.0.1, a driver thread) with an autofocused text field; it shows every key it gets, reversed and counted ('seen' + keys reversed + 'end' + count), document.hasFocus(), the active element, and its cycle (?c=N)
cycle 1: Cmd-Shift-L opens a browser tab
cycle 1: the address bar takes the keys

cycle 1: the page loaded from the address bar; the page's text field is its active element and the focus model says browserPage (empty page variant: the page shows no text before a key, so only the key window is checked)
cycle A: a real Cmd-Q (Keep) and reopen; no key until the restored page has loaded

cycle A: the restored page loaded; its text field is the active element and the focus model says browserPage (empty page variant: the page shows no text before a key, so only the key window is checked)
cycle A: then a word with real plain keys (CuaDriver desktop scope)
cycle A: every key reached the restored page in order (shown reversed) and the field shows the word

cycle B: a real Cmd-Q (Keep), reopen, and as soon as the main window is listed only plain keys (a word, no modifier) (the restored page may still be loading: the app must hold or deliver the keys; a red here can be that, not the key window)
cycle B: every key typed at once reached the restored page in order (shown reversed) and the field shows the word

finally.title: evidence: debug.focus at the end (creation_hold and creation_hold_end per window; reopen-f4)
